description: QNSPECT is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office for Costal Management Digital Coast; Dewberry. Also known as the Nonpoint Source Pollution and Erosion Comparison Tool, QNSPECT is a QGIS plug-in that allows users to estimate nonpoint-source pollution and erosion processes within watersheds. Users can then compare pollutant and sediment loads based on different scenarios. The tool is designed to be broadly applicable for coastal and non-coastal areas alike. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Water Quality. Assets: Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
